# components/scroll-area

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.ts from components/scroll-area/scroll-area.ts — edit the source, then `deno task docs`. -->

Import: `import { ScrollArea } from "@tundralibs/ui/scroll-area"`

Shown on its demo page (`deno task build:demos`, then `demo/components/scroll-area.html`). Guides: [Getting started](../UI-Getting-Started.md) · [rAPId integration](../UI-Rapid.md) · [Theming](../UI-Theming.md).

## Functions

### `ScrollArea`

```ts
ScrollArea(props: ScrollAreaProps): Html
```

A scroll container with a styled scrollbar (thin, token colours, on
every engine) and edge shadows that appear only where there is more to
scroll — pure CSS (`background-attachment: local`), no script. Give it a
`label` when its content has no focusable children, so the keyboard can
reach and scroll it.

## Types

### `ScrollAreaAxis`

Which way the area scrolls.

- `"y"`
- `"x"`
- `"both"`

### `ScrollAreaSize`

Height steps: 240 / 400 / 600px (themes retune `--scroll-area-max-height`).

- `"sm"`
- `"md"`
- `"lg"`

### `ScrollAreaProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `content` | `Html` | yes |  |
| `axis` | `ScrollAreaAxis` |  |  |
| `maxHeight` | `ScrollAreaSize` |  | Caps the height (a vertical or both-axis area); without it the area fills its box. |
| `shadows` | `boolean` |  | Edge shadows that show there is more to scroll. @default true |
| `thin` | `boolean` |  | A thinner scrollbar track. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Names the region (`role="region"` + `aria-label`) and makes it keyboard-scrollable (`tabindex="0"`) — needed when the content holds nothing focusable, or a keyboard user could never scroll it. |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  |  |

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### A capped list

Edge shadows appear only where there is more to scroll — pure CSS, no script.

```ts
ScrollArea({
  maxHeight: "sm",
  content: html`
    <ul class="menu__list">
      <li><a class="menu__link" href="/tags/ui">ui</a></li>
    </ul>
  `,
})
```

```html
<div class="scroll-area scroll-area--y scroll-area--sm">
  <ul class="menu__list">
    <li>
      <a class="menu__link" href="/tags/ui">ui</a>
    </li>
  </ul>
</div>
```

### A wide table

Give an area whose content has nothing focusable a `label`: it becomes a named region the keyboard can scroll.

```ts
ScrollArea({
  axis: "x",
  label: "Monthly figures",
  content: html`
    <table>
      <tr>
        <td>Jan</td>
        <td>Feb</td>
        <td>Mar</td>
      </tr>
    </table>
  `,
})
```

```html
<div class="scroll-area scroll-area--x" role="region" aria-label="Monthly figures" tabindex="0">
  <table>
    <tr>
      <td>Jan</td>
      <td>Feb</td>
      <td>Mar</td>
    </tr>
  </table>
</div>
```

Classes defined by `components/scroll-area/scroll-area.css` — structural, token-driven; override from an unlayered stylesheet (see [Theming](../UI-Theming.md)):

`.scroll-area`, `.scroll-area--both`, `.scroll-area--lg`, `.scroll-area--md`, `.scroll-area--plain`, `.scroll-area--sm`, `.scroll-area--thin`, `.scroll-area--x`, `.scroll-area--y`
